summary: First-finish smoke test on WhyMob CRM. Backend healthy (login, /auth/me, /dashboard/kpis, /dashboard/funnel all 200; discard-lead-without-reason correctly rejected 400). Frontend E2E covered login->dashboard->funnel->leads (create lead + discard validation)->opportunities->proposals->proposal-detail->orders->clients->manufacturers->products->users (admin only)->logout. All 12 checkpoints passed.
passed: GET /api/dashboard/kpis returns leads_open=2, won_value=9000, won_vab=3500, orders_count=1, conversion_rate=100
PATCH /api/leads/{id} status=descartada without lost_reason -> 400 'Motivo obrigatório ao descartar lead'
Login UI -> lands on Dashboard (route '/'), KPI testids visible (kpi-leads-open, kpi-conv-rate, kpi-won-value, kpi-won-vab, kpi-orders)
Create Lead via new-lead-btn dialog (lead-description-input, lead-value-input, lead-save-btn) - lead appears in list
Discard lead flow: discard-lead-{id} opens dialog with lead-discard-confirm; confirm without reason handled
Proposals list -> detail page loads with save-proposal-btn
Master data pages: new-client-btn, new-manuf-btn, new-product-btn all present
action_items: Minor: after successful login the app redirects to '/' rather than '/dashboard'. Route works because Dashboard is default; no action strictly required, but if PRD expects '/dashboard', update Login redirect or route mapping.
Minor: when confirming lead discard without reason no visible error toast/alert was surfaced in the DOM (backend correctly returns 400). Consider showing user-facing error feedback in UI.
